samples.description: A basic sample scene using Rocketbox character in 2D display and in VR

A Gemini Live realtime voice+vision agent on a Rocketbox character

Realtime per-turn retrieval over a baked document corpus. The agent calls a search_knowledge tool, queries are embedded with gemini-embedding-001, and only the top-K chunks enter the prompt. Fictional deep-ocean research station corpus. Requires baking.

samples.displayName: Knowledge Grounding — Long Document via Prompt
samples.description: Whole-document grounding with no chunking, embedding, or baking. The full corpus is injected into the prompt at session start. Fictional museum curator persona. Zero setup beyond an API key.
A markdown corpus describing the SDK itself, for grounding an agent that can explain how it works
Minimal code samples: HelloAgent, ToolCalling, CustomCallbacks. Complements the scene-based samples.
